content.title: Convert PDF to Word: Free and On-Device Options
content.meta_description: Learn how to turn a PDF into an editable Word document or extract text for free using Google Docs, desktop Word, or on-device mobile OCR.
content.h1: How to Convert a PDF to Word for Free
content.quick_answer: You can convert a PDF to an editable document for free using Google Docs on Google Drive or Microsoft Word on desktop if you already own a licence. Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit extracts text to plain text for free using on-device OCR, while exporting directly to Word (.docx) requires a Pro purchase.
intro: You received a project brief as a PDF, but you need to revise paragraphs, update copy, and adjust the layout directly inside Microsoft Word. Re-typing pages by hand takes hours, but most conversion utilities push you toward recurring monthly subscriptions.

When you search for free PDF-to-Word options, you will encounter distinct trade-offs between formatting quality, file privacy, and software price. This guide compares truly free conversion workarounds with mobile document extraction methods so you can choose the right workflow for your file.
content.steps_heading: How to Turn a PDF into an Editable Document Using the App

steps.title: Open your PDF file
steps.detail: Import your PDF document directly into Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit from the Files app or your email. Make sure every page is properly oriented before processing so the characters align correctly.

steps.title: Run on-device text recognition (OCR)
steps.detail: Choose on-device text recognition (OCR) to read the printed text across your pages without sending data to an external server. Check that your PDF contains clean, readable typography, as handwriting accuracy depends on neatness and contrast.

steps.title: Copy the text or export to .txt for free
steps.detail: Extract the recognised text for free by copying it straight to your clipboard or exporting it as a .txt file. You can paste this raw text directly into any new Microsoft Word document on your iPhone or iPad.

steps.title: Export directly to Word (.docx) with Pro
steps.detail: If you want to keep original paragraph structures and basic formatting intact, use the Export to Word (.docx) Pro feature. Review the converted .docx file inside Microsoft Word to ensure line wraps and section headings match your requirements.

steps.title: Share the completed document
steps.detail: Save your extracted or converted document using the export menu. Send the finished file to Microsoft Word via Files, AirDrop, or Mail, or store it in iCloud Drive, Google Drive, or Dropbox.

content.alternatives_heading: Free Alternative Ways to Convert a PDF to Word

alternatives.how: Upload your PDF to Google Drive on a computer or browser, right-click the file, and select Open with > Google Docs. Google Docs will run automated text recognition and generate an editable text document you can download as a .docx file.
alternatives.best_for: Clean, printed PDFs where basic text editing is all you need and complex design elements do not matter.
alternatives.limitation: Formatting is often lost, especially with multi-column layouts, tables, or complex graphic elements.

alternatives.how: Launch Microsoft Word on your desktop computer, click File > Open, and select your PDF file. Word automatically converts the PDF into an editable Word document while attempting to preserve original fonts and paragraphs.
alternatives.best_for: Users who already subscribe to Microsoft 365 or own a standalone Office desktop package.
alternatives.limitation: Complex layouts may not convert exactly, and it requires a paid Microsoft 365 or Office licence to use.

alternatives.how: Upload your PDF into a web-based conversion tool in your browser and download the resulting .docx file after remote processing completes.
alternatives.best_for: One-off public documents that contain no private personal or corporate information.
alternatives.limitation: They require uploading your document to a third-party server, and free tiers frequently enforce daily limits and strict file size caps.

content.features_heading: App Features for PDF and Document Conversion

feature_points.benefit: Converts a PDF or scan into an editable Word document while preserving paragraphs and basic layout through the OCR layer.
Extracts text from printed PDF pages on your device for free, allowing you to copy content into Word without internet access or server uploads.
Transfers converted files straight to the desktop or mobile Word app via AirDrop, Mail, Files, or cloud storage providers like iCloud Drive.

content.tips_heading: Tips for Clean PDF to Word Conversion
tips: Inspect scanned PDF pages for straight alignment before running OCR, as skewed pages can lead to jumbled words and broken sentences.
If your original PDF was created from clear digital text rather than a physical paper scan, desktop Word and Google Docs will convert paragraphs with fewer errors.
Never upload confidential contracts, IDs, or financial records to free online web converters because those files pass through external third-party servers.
To simply sign an existing form without altering its layout or converting it to Word, add your signature directly using our guide on how to sign a PDF on iPhone.

faqs.question: Is converting PDF to editable Word (.docx) free in Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit?
faqs.answer: Exporting directly to an editable Word (.docx) file is a Pro feature that requires an in-app purchase. However, the app includes on-device text recognition (OCR) for free, which lets you extract printed text and export it as a .txt file or copy it into Word.

faqs.question: How can I extract text from a PDF for free using on-device OCR?
faqs.answer: Open your PDF in Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit and select on-device text recognition. The app extracts printed text locally without uploading your document, allowing you to copy the words directly to your clipboard or save them as a plain text file at zero cost.

faqs.question: Can Google Docs convert a PDF to an editable document for free?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you upload your PDF to Google Drive and choose Open with > Google Docs, Google converts the file into an editable document. While this method is free, formatting is often lost and it works best on clean, printed pages.

faqs.question: Can Microsoft Word open and edit PDF files directly?
faqs.answer: Microsoft Word for desktop can open a PDF directly and convert it into an editable document. Complex layouts may not convert exactly, and the feature requires a paid Microsoft 365 or Office licence, so it is only free if you already have one.

faqs.question: What are the privacy risks of free online PDF-to-Word converter websites?
faqs.answer: Free online converter websites require uploading your file to a third-party server for processing. This presents significant privacy risks for sensitive files such as identity documents, legal contracts, and financial statements, and free sites often limit daily file use.
